verses.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.pt: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos de Israel, os quais saíram da terra do Egito por seus esquadrões, sob a condução de Moisés e Arão.
verses.en_web: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt in their armies, under the direction of Moses and Aaron.

verses.en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.pt: E Moisés escreveu suas saídas conforme suas jornadas por ordem do SENHOR. Estas, pois, são suas jornadas conforme suas partidas.
verses.en_web: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.en_bbe: And the stages of their journey on their way out were put down in writing by Moses at the order of the Lord: these are the stages of their journey and the way they went.

verses.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.pt: De Ramessés partiram no mês primeiro, aos quinze dias do mês primeiro: no segundo dia da páscoa saíram os filhos de Israel com mão alta, à vista de todos os egípcios.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.en_bbe: On the fifteenth day of the first month they went out from Rameses; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out by the power of the Lord before the eyes of all the Egyptians,

verses.en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.pt: Estavam enterrando os egípcios os que o SENHOR havia matado deles, a todo primogênito; havendo o SENHOR feito também juízos em seus deuses.
verses.en_web: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.
verses.en_bbe: While the Egyptians were placing in the earth the bodies of their sons on whom the Lord had sent destruction: and their gods had been judged by him.

verses.en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.pt: Partiram, pois, os filhos de Israel de Ramessés, e assentaram acampamento em Sucote.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel went from Rameses and put up their tents in Succoth.

verses.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.pt: E partindo de Sucote, assentaram em Etã, que está ao extremo do deserto.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Succoth and put up their tents in Etham on the edge of the waste land.

verses.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.pt: E partindo de Etã, voltaram sobre Pi-Hairote, que está diante de Baal-Zefom, e assentaram diante de Migdol.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
verses.en_bbe: And from Etham, turning back to Pi-hahiroth which is before Baal-zephon, they put up their tents before Migdol.

verses.en: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.pt: E partindo de Pi-Hairote, passaram por meio do mar ao deserto, e andaram caminho de três dias pelo deserto de Etã, e assentaram em Mara.
verses.en_web: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
verses.en_bbe: And journeying on from before Hahiroth, they went through the sea into the waste land: they went three days' journey through the waste land of Etham and put up their tents in Marah.

verses.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.pt: E partindo de Mara, vieram a Elim, de onde havia doze fontes de águas, e setenta palmeiras; e assentaram ali.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.
verses.en_bbe: And from Marah they went on to Elim: and in Elim there were twelve water-springs and seventy palm-trees; and they put up their tents there.

verses.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.pt: E partidos de Elim, assentaram junto ao mar Vermelho.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Elim and put up their tents by the Red Sea.

verses.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.pt: E partidos do mar Vermelho, assentaram no deserto de Sim.
verses.en_web: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.en_bbe: Then from the Red Sea they went on and put up their tents in the waste land of Sin.

verses.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.pt: E partidos do deserto de Sim, assentaram em Dofca.
verses.en_web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from the waste land of Sin, and put up their tents in Dophkah.

verses.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.pt: E partidos de Dofca, assentaram em Alus.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Dophkah, and put up their tents in Alush.

verses.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.pt: E partidos de Alus, assentaram em Refidim, onde o povo não teve águas para beber.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Alush, and put up their tents in Rephidim, where there was no drinking-water for the people.

verses.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.pt: E partidos de Refidim, assentaram no deserto de Sinai.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Rephidim, and put up their tents in the waste land of Sinai.

verses.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.pt: E partidos do deserto de Sinai, assentaram em Quibrote-Taavá.
verses.en_web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from the waste land of Sinai and put up their tents in Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.en: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.pt: E partidos de Quibrote-Taavá, assentaram em Hazerote.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Kibroth-hattaavah, and put up their tents in Hazeroth.

verses.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Hazerote, assentaram em Ritmá.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Hazeroth, and put up their tents in Rithmah.

verses.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
verses.pt: E partidos de Ritmá, assentaram em Rimom-Perez.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Rithmah, and put up their tents in Rimmon-perez.

verses.en: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Rimom-Perez, assentaram em Libna.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Rimmon-perez, and put up their tents in Libnah.

verses.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Libna, assentaram em Rissa.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Libnah, and put up their tents in Rissah.

verses.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Rissa, assentaram em Queelata,
verses.en_web: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Rissah, and put up their tents in Kehelathah.

verses.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.pt: E partidos de Queelata, assentaram no monte de Séfer.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Kehelathah, and put up their tents in Mount Shepher.

verses.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.pt: E partidos do monte de Séfer, assentaram em Harada.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Mount Shepher, and put up their tents in Haradah.

verses.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.pt: E partidos de Harada, assentaram em Maquelote.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Haradah, and put up their tents in Makheloth.

verses.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.pt: E partidos de Maquelote, assentaram em Taate.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Makheloth, and put up their tents in Tahath.

verses.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Taate, assentaram em Tera.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Tahath, and put up their tents in Terah.

verses.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Tera, assentaram em Mitca.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Terah, and put up their tents in Mithkah.

verses.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Mitca, assentaram em Hasmona.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Mithkah, and put up their tents in Hashmonah.

verses.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.pt: E partidos de Hasmona, assentaram em Moserote.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Hashmonah, and put up their tents in Moseroth.

verses.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.pt: E partidos de Moserote, assentaram em Bene-Jaacã.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Moseroth, and put up their tents in Bene-jaakan.

verses.en: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
verses.pt: E partidos de Bene-Jaacã, assentaram em Hor-Gidgade.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Bene-jaakan, and put up their tents in Hor-haggidgad.

verses.en: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Hor-Gidgade, assentaram em Jotbatá.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Hor-haggidgad, and put up their tents in Jotbathah.

verses.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.pt: E partidos de Jotbatá, assentaram em Abrona.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Jotbathah, and put up their tents in Abronah.

verses.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
verses.pt: E partidos de Abrona, assentaram em Eziom-Geber.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Abronah, and put up their tents in Ezion-geber.

verses.en: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.pt: E partidos de Eziom-Geber, assentaram no deserto de Zim, que é Cades.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Ezion-geber, and put up their tents in the waste land of Zin (which is Kadesh).

verses.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.pt: E partidos de Cades, assentaram no monte de Hor, na extremidade da terra de Edom.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Kadesh, and put up their tents in Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.

verses.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.pt: E subiu Arão o sacerdote ao monte de Hor, conforme o dito do SENHOR, e ali morreu aos quarenta anos da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no mês quinto, no primeiro dia do mês.
verses.en_web: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.en_bbe: And Aaron the priest went up into the mountain at the order of the Lord, and came to his death there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

verses.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.pt: E era Arão de idade de cento e vinte e três anos, quando morreu no monte de Hor.
verses.en_web: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
verses.en_bbe: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old at the time of his death in Mount Hor.

verses.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava ao sul na terra de Canaã, ouviu como haviam vindo os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And news of the coming of the children of Israel came to the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who was living in the South in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.pt: E partidos do monte de Hor, assentaram em Zalmona.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
verses.en_bbe: And from Mount Hor they went on, and put up their tents in Zalmonah.

verses.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.pt: E partidos de Zalmona, assentaram em Punom.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Zalmonah, and put up their tents in Punon.

verses.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.pt: E partidos de Punom, assentaram em Obote.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Punon, and put up their tents in Oboth.

verses.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.pt: E partidos de Obote, assentaram em Ijé-Abarim; no termo de Moabe.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Oboth, and put up their tents in Iye-abarim at the edge of Moab.

verses.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.pt: E partidos de Ijé-Abarim, assentaram em Dibom-Gade.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Iyim, and put up their tents in Dibon-gad.

verses.en: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.pt: E partidos de Dibom-Gade, assentaram em Almom-Diblataim.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
verses.en_bbe: And from Dibon-gad they went on, and put up their tents in Almon-diblathaim.

verses.en: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.pt: E partidos de Almom-Diblataim, assentaram nos montes de Abarim, diante de Nebo.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.en_bbe: And from Almon-diblathaim they went on, and put up their tents in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.pt: E partidos dos montes de Abarim, assentaram nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
verses.en_web: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from the mountains of Abarim, and put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho;

verses.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.pt: Finalmente assentaram junto ao Jordão, desde Bete-Jesimote até Abel-Sitim, nos campos de Moabe.
verses.en_web: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.en_bbe: Planting their tents by the side of Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the lowlands of Moab.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés nos campos de Moabe junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão à terra de Canaã,
verses.en_web: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, When you go over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

verses.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.pt: Expulsareis a todos os moradores daquela terra de diante de vós, e destruireis todas suas imagens esculpidas, e todas as suas imagens de fundição, e arruinareis todos os seus altares pagãos;
verses.en_web: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
verses.en_bbe: See that all the people of the land are forced out from before you, and put to destruction all their pictured stones, and all their metal images, and all their high places:

verses.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.pt: E expulsareis os moradores da terra, e habitareis nela; porque eu a dei a vós para que a possuais.
verses.en_web: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: And take the land for yourselves, for your resting-place: for to you I have given the land as your heritage.

verses.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.pt: E herdareis a terra por sortes por vossas famílias: aos muitos dareis muito por sua herança, e aos poucos dareis menos por herança sua: onde lhe sair a sorte, ali a terá cada um: pelas tribos de vossos pais herdareis.
verses.en_web: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.en_bbe: And you will take up your heritage in the land by the decision of the Lord, to every family its part; the greater the family the greater its heritage, and the smaller the family the smaller will be its heritage; wherever the decision of the Lord gives to any man his part, that will be his; distribution will be made to you by your fathers' tribes.

verses.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.pt: E se não expulsardes os moradores daquela terra de diante de vós, sucederá que os que deixardes deles serão por aguilhões em vossos olhos, e por espinhos em vossos lados, e vos afligirão sobre a terra em que vós habitardes.
verses.en_web: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
verses.en_bbe: But if you are slow in driving out the people of the land, then those of them who are still there will be like pin-points in your eyes and like thorns in your sides, troubling you in the land where you are living.

verses.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.pt: Será também, que farei a vós como eu pensei fazer a eles.
verses.en_web: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about that as it was my purpose to do to them, so I will do to you.
